clock_and_counter_definitions.cpu_fields: Corrected 428b protocol states wait4 supplies comparison CPU time; proc_pid_rusage supplies instruction/cycle/QoS counters. The raw timing records retain user_cpu_seconds and system_cpu_seconds plus raw ri_user_time/ri_system_time, with both surfaces and their difference. Do not treat these accounting surfaces as interchangeable.
clock_and_counter_definitions.cycle_counter: darwin_rusage_v4.ri_cycles: raw per-process unsigned integer count (count, not seconds).
clock_and_counter_definitions.duration_field: seconds: time.perf_counter() delta, starting immediately before subprocess.Popen and stopping after waitid observes process exit. It covers native process creation through complete output and exit; Darwin counter collection and wait4 reap occur afterward.
clock_and_counter_definitions.instruction_counter: darwin_rusage_v4.ri_instructions: raw per-process unsigned integer count (count, not seconds).
clock_and_counter_definitions.mach_timebase: mach_timebase_numer=125 and denom=3 are recorded as provenance for Darwin absolute-time values; the duration field is independently measured with Python time.perf_counter, not calculated from the Mach timebase.
clock_and_counter_definitions.provenance: rusage_flavor=4; rusage_struct_bytes=296; sampled through proc_pid_rusage while child PID remains available; headers and SHA-256s are included on each diagnostic record.
clock_and_counter_definitions.scope: Whole child process only, including startup and complete output; proc_pid_rusage snapshot taken post-exit before child reap. No per-operator, per-function, per-thread, or dispatch-site counter attribution; no periodic counter time series.

reported_summary.duration_semantics: seconds per complete native child call; each cell median is over three calls.

sampling_and_attribution.attribution_result: Only aggregate process-level instruction/cycle totals. No retained instruction-pointer samples, call stacks, function attribution, branch/dispatch-site counts, or operator spans in the directly targeted comparison records.
sampling_and_attribution.counter_method: Darwin proc_pid_rusage(pid, RUSAGE_INFO_V4) collects 35 uint64_t process-wide counters while the child PID remains queryable after exit; wait4 supplies comparative CPU seconds in corrected 428b. Counter reads occur after the duration clock stops.
sampling_and_attribution.execution_context: Same retained Vortex input is prehashed; public SQL workflow; complete output and exit checked; OS cache and ordinary desktop activity uncontrolled; same observer for both roles.
sampling_and_attribution.per_call_sampling: One post-exit process counter snapshot per invocation; not sampled profiling.

The target extraction covers Q3/Q23/Q29 only: 3 queries x 2 orders x 3 runs x 2 roles = 36 process records. Each timing record has one post-exit proc_pid_rusage flavor-4 snapshot; this is not sampled profiling.

scope.note: The 48-call comparison is four queries x 12 calls; this extraction contains all 36 Q3/Q23/Q29 calls relevant to the reported instruction-count statement. Q34 is outside the requested target set.
